name: reservation
description: Reservation hotel landing page: Next.js frontend, NestJS API and PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && node scripts/ensure-env.mjs && npm run db:start && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix backend run start" "npm --prefix frontend run start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
